Name: Static Fishing Bar - Fixed Position Fishing Minigame
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
Thanks [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/3082852-pixietj/]PixieTJ[/url] for the idea! Was asked for two features, but I wasn't able to get that scaling to work, so currently the mod only used to change Fishing Bar UI positioning. maybe later I could figure out how to scale that UI or others too!



[b]Tired of chasing the fishing UI with your eyes?
[/b]
By default, Stardew Valley places the fishing minigame bar right over your character's head. If your character moves, the camera pans, or you are fishing near the edge of the map, the UI moves with you.

[b]Static Fishing Bar[/b] solves this by anchoring the fishing interface to a specific spot on your screen. Whether you want it dead center, off to the side, or in the corner, it stays exactly where you put it.


[size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size]


[b]Features

[/b][list]
[*][b]Fixed Position:[/b] The fishing bar no longer floats in the game world; it is locked to your screen (UI layer).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Fully Customizable:[/b] Use the config menu to slide the bar to any X (Horizontal) or Y (Vertical) position you prefer.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Resolution Friendly:[/b] Works on any resolution or zoom level.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41334/41334-1768612442-1687841378.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41334/41334-1768612442-1153714176.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41334/41334-1768612442-1719318832.png[/img]﻿[b]Configuration

[/b]This mod works best with [b][url=https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fmods%2F5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][/b].

[list=1]
[*]Open the GMCM menu in-game.

[*]Go to [b]Static Fishing Bar[/b].

[*][b]Enabled:[/b] Toggle the mod on/off.

[*][b]Position X (%):[/b] Slide to move the bar Left (0) or Right (1).

[*][b]Position Y (%):[/b] Slide to move the bar Top (0) or Bottom (1).
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41334/41334-1768612440-758996516.png[/img]

[b]Installation

[/b][list=1]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fsmapi.io%2F]SMAPI[/url][/b].

[*](Optional but Recommended) Install [b][url=https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fmods%2F5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b].

[*]Download this mod.

[*]Unzip the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.

[*]Run the game!

[/list][b]Compatibility

[/b][list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*]Should work with any texture replacement mods (e.g., "Vintage Interface") as this mod only changes the position, not the graphics.
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] This is a client-side mod. It only affects your screen. You can use it even if other players don't have it.
[/list][line]
